newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Dutch Nutreco applies for Amsterdam listing.
newsitem.headline: Dutch Nutreco applies for Amsterdam listing.

text.p: Dutch feeds group Nutreco Holding NV said on Friday it had applied for listing on the Amsterdam stock exchange for June 3 and shares would be priced at between 33 and 37 guilders.
Nutreco, which manufactures animal and fish feeds, said it planned to issue 14,811,000 shares, of which 9,525,000 would be sold by existing shareholders and the remainder by Nutreco.
The prospectus will be available on May 20 and subscription via a bookbuilding system is expected to run until June 2, Nutreco said in a statement.
Rabo Securities and Goldman Sachs will act as joint global co-ordinators for the issue.
Under a greenshoe option, certain selling shareholders have granted the lead managers the option to buy up to an additional 2,221,650 shares within 30 days of the pricing date.
Nutreco said the offering would enable it to expand its shareholder base and secure access to the capital markets in order to finance future growth.
In addition, the listing would provide a liquid trading market for Nutreco shareholders, the company said.
Nutreco unveiled 1996 profits of 40.4 million guilders in April, up 50 percent from the previous year.
Operating income rose 13.3 percent to 128 million guilders and Nutreco said it expected 1997 operating results to show a further improvement if current market conditions persisted.
It employs 5,500 people in 60 locations in 15 countries.
